cards.card_text: Against Assyria, Micah says, “We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.” EIGHT leaders, friend, and the closest thing to leadership in my junk drawer was the dead batteries arguing over who had the most charge left!
cards.verse_text: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
